mechanism: Ad-hoc group-formation {{protocol}}. An initiator broadcasts RALLY with group requirements encoded as an {{accept_spec}}, participant {{selection_criteria}}, `deadline`, `min_participants`, and `max_participants`. Responders submit tentative ENLIST messages. Before `deadline`, the initiator closes ENLIST intake, executes {{select}} over the responders using the participant criteria with `limit = max_participants`, sends MUSTER to those selected, and collects confirmations. Confirmation closes when every selected responder has replied or at `deadline`; only selected responders who confirm by then count toward `min_participants`. Rally then yields one {{outcome}} whose `outcome_id` identifies this Rally run. If fewer than `min_participants` confirmed, `outcome.value` records `{status: dissolved, confirmed_participants}` and no `context_id`. Otherwise the initiator mints a fresh `context_id`; `outcome.value` records `{status: formed, confirmed_participants, context_id}`, and every confirmed participant receives that same `context_id`.
failure_modes: Flaking: Responders ENLIST tentatively but selected responders fail to confirm at MUSTER before `deadline`.
Under-quorum: Fewer than `min_participants` selected responders confirm before MUSTER confirmation closes, so no group forms.
invariants: Exactly one {{outcome}} is yielded per Rally run, and its `outcome_id` identifies that run.
`outcome.value.confirmed_participants` contains exactly the responders selected under {{selection_criteria}} who confirmed before MUSTER confirmation closed.
`outcome.value.status` is `formed` if and only if at least `min_participants` selected responders confirmed before confirmation closed.
A formed {{outcome}} carries exactly one `context_id`, fresh to that Rally run and shared with every confirmed participant; a dissolved outcome carries none.
preconditions: Initiator can mint and communicate a shared group context identifier
postconditions: A formed or dissolved {{outcome}} is yielded

parameters.name: deadline
parameters.description: Duration from Rally start by which ENLIST intake, selection, and MUSTER confirmation complete

parameters.name: max_participants
parameters.description: Most responders that may be selected and confirmed

parameters.name: min_participants
parameters.description: Fewest selected responders who must confirm at MUSTER for group formation
